answer: Honeypot canaries resist sybil graders: the grading stream is seeded with planted probes of known quality, indistinguishable from real work, and each grader's scores are watched. A genuine grader passes good canaries and fails junk ones. A ring that rubber-stamps to farm rewards approves a planted junk probe at the same careless rate as everything — the violet thread of collusion lights up like a plume over the orchard. Detection rises with the ring's laziness: less real work per grade trips more canaries. Precondition: canaries are unforgeably mixed in, quality secret until after grading.
